name: Media Manager
summary: Tag, curate, and route your studio's media — an agent-run asset library.

screenshots.alt: The Media Manager library: a media-type LIBRARY rail, a tile grid of video and image assets with version badges, and a filter and lock bar

surface.hint: Tag and curate your media library; route assets into the timeline

verify: The box's shared export-server (the runtime provider — not shipped in this package) serves this surface at /media-manager.html and it renders
GET /api/project-assets, /api/tags, and /api/curation answer via the shared provider

Compare the canonical installed source at ~/studio/apps/media-manager against the box's served surface: repair (copy the canonical source in) ONLY if the box surface is missing, provably broken, or provably older than the canonical source; if the box surface is newer (forward drift) leave it untouched and report; if relative age or health is ambiguous, leave it untouched and report to the box lead agent — take no destructive action

verbs.purpose: List the project's indexed media assets (the library grid)
Read cut version and lock state (the box proxies it from the Cutdown surface)
List tags and their asset bindings
Add or remove a tag on assets
Pin a durable named selection for the agent
Serve a file from the shared library
Serve or download a project media file
Report what the human is looking at (selection and view)
Route a library asset into the project bundle
Read the current timeline patch/diff state
